## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Full `npm test` suite passes
- [ ] New behavior has regression coverage
- [ ] Real verification is distinguished from mocks
- [ ] Runtime changes were packaged and the VSIX contents inspected

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, logs, local stores, prompts, source code, or conversation content are included
- [ ] Workspace trust, sandbox, and explicit approval behavior are preserved
- [ ] New persistent or network data is documented
- [ ] Failure behavior is fail closed where appropriate

## Documentation and limitations

List updated documentation, manual checks, and anything not independently verified.
